audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding sentence is verbatim at McAllister & McAllister 1991:134 in the SIL PDF we hold (PDF p. 21), and the Hartzler afterword caveat is verbatim at pp. 141-142. (2) Deciding source: a 1991 SIL field phonology article, the only description of Doutai in existence per Glottolog (1 descriptive ref) and the SIL archive (1 item for tds); Clouse 1997 (held) independently states stress is non-contrastive across Lakes Plain and defers to McAllister for Doutai. No reference grammar, dissertation, JIPA illustration or instrumental study was found in any bibliography opened; the language is moribund (~335 speakers in 1991). (3) list of works to obtain: empty — nothing unheld is known to exist.
